item.title: Show HN: Open-source Grok Bot alternative
item.summary: When Grok bot came out, the only way to use it was with a $200 Cursor subscription. I burned through almost 50% of my usage in 3 hours. That's not sustainable, so I figured I'd build my own and plug in my own inference. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49314312 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
